items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1958-09-24
items.q: The best ball trombone player, ragtime trombone player, I think in the, that I've never heard no one play like him. Bill Gallaty.

ctx.x: Those people that aren't living were sort of interested in them, you know, because they can't speak for themselves. Yeah, yeah.

Yellow, you see his name was Al C. Nunez. We call him Yellow. Al C. Nunez. He was up north for about 15 years. And he came down here and got on the police force. More to get in the band, you know. To have him in the band, he went to the police force, you know. Yes. And he died here. And the other was a very good, wonderful faker. You see, in the days we had clarinet players. We had trombone players. But they could read. But they couldn't fake. You understand? See? They couldn't, they still, you know, other words…
I've seen his picture and his son plays trombone.
